initialize_test_parser: initialize an argparse parser with test-specific options like aspect_ratio, phase, eval mode, and num_test
parse_test_options: parse command-line test options for the pix2pix4depth model with eval mode and num_test settings
configure_test_phase: configure the test phase options with aspect ratio, eval mode, and number of test images
set_test_defaults: set default test values including model pix2pix4depth and load_size matching crop_size
gather_test_options: gather and parse all test options inherited from BaseOptions plus test-specific arguments
